note: range = <base>..<head>; check head out detached in the bench clone and pass --base-ref <base> --committed-only. bytes = git diff base head (all files, tests and docs included). Ground truth is the defect the later fix commit F corrected, read from F's diff; line numbers are in head's version of the file.

defect.text: commandMentions treats an empty word as found in every command (strings.Contains(x, "") is true), so with an empty binary path CommandOwnedBy/carries answer on the family token alone.
parseStatusArgs scans the whole line for --only/--cwd: an empty --cwd value is accepted, '--cwd --only registry' takes '--only' as the directory, and unknown arguments are silently ignored.
A path filepath.Rel cannot make relative is dropped with 'return nil', so Files() returns a listing that claims to be the whole tree but silently lacks files; it must be an error of the walk.
SnippetAt has no guard for a zero or negative budget; the window arithmetic after len(content) <= budget slices with it and panics.
WaitsForHop answers true for a chain role the canonical role set does not know, so the guard denial tells the builder to append a hop for an unknown role instead of keeping the plain reason.
PiPackageDir returns ConfigRoot itself, so with --target all the Pi package is built into, and removed from, the directory the other runtimes keep their settings in; it must be <base>/pi/labdrian-pi.
workflow open reads the feature document and goal file with os.Stat and os.ReadFile, which follow links and block on a pipe; it must read a regular, non-link, bounded file as the builder guard does.
rotateLog ignores the error of each os.Rename in the shift loop, so a failed shift lets the next rename land on a .N that was not moved and drops that log.
The optional name of the importSpec pattern accepts a Go keyword, so a removed line such as return "config.json" is read as the removal of an import of a non-standard module.

The stop hook keys its asked marker by base and head only, so a need that appears after an earlier block in the same session (the sweeper of a sweep that fired) finds the marker present and is never asked.
readRoles returns the error of a role record that does not read back or hold even while the Risk trailer of the commit fails, so the trailer error that review.Needs lists first is never met.

Archive builds the sweep copies with git archive, which applies the committed .gitattributes (export-ignore drops files, export-subst rewrites them) and the eol and autocrlf settings, so the analyzers run on a tree that is not the commit's.

The step deletes review_lens_count from every committed actuals record before validating it, so the lens-count check never runs on a record that carries a count, not only on the one written before rows were stored.

checkLensCount refuses a count that no stored result backs only when the number differs from the counted rows, so review_lens_count 0 for a change with no stored review result passes as 0 equals the 0 rows.
exemptedHead accepts a stored exemption whose base is not the first parent of its head, so an exemption of C2..C4 steps over a blocked review of C2..C3 and check --base C0 --head C4 exits 0.
readFile opens a stored result with os.Open, which waits on a pipe put at the name after the look, and accepts any opened file with the inode of the one looked at without requiring a regular file.
create returns a plain failure when the flush of the directory fails after the file is already linked, so a result that is stored is reported as not stored and a retry stores it a second time.
Create looks at the directories with Lstat and then stages and links by path, so a directory replaced by a symbolic link between the look and the use redirects the write out of odd/review-results.
writeReviewJSON ignores the error of the write to stdout and exits 0, so a failed write (a pipe whose reader has gone, a full disk) is reported as success.
Worktree answers taken for any error of Locate, including a git that could not be started or ran out of time, so a failure of git is reported as a path held by something else.
When two binds of one head race, the one whose AddWorktree loses returns that error instead of reusing the worktree the other made at that head.
Candidate.Short slices Head[:12] with no length check, so it panics on the zero Candidate.
checkPaths compares the inspected paths with the paths of the diff as sets, so a reply that lists one path twice passes as having inspected the diff.
